# A real SMTP conversation with Mailpit v1.34.0 (docker.io/axllent/mailpit:latest on 2026-11-19)
# started with a certificate and a password file (MP_SMTP_TLS_CERT, MP_SMTP_TLS_KEY,
# MP_SMTP_AUTH_FILE): it then demands STARTTLS and a login.
# Recorded with a raw socket; "C:" is what the client sent, "S:" what Mailpit answered.
# Only the container's host name was changed, to "relay", and the login is described instead
# of shown. The fake relay in smtp_test.go answers with these lines.
S: 220 relay Mailpit ESMTP Service ready
C: EHLO workstation.example
S: 250-relay greets workstation.example
S: 250-SIZE 52428800
S: 250-STARTTLS
S: 250-AUTH LOGIN PLAIN
S: 250-ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES
S: 250-8BITMIME
S: 250 SMTPUTF8
C: MAIL FROM:<upkeep@example.net>
S: 530 5.7.0 Must issue a STARTTLS command first
C: AUTH PLAIN <upkeep, right password>
S: 530 5.7.0 Must issue a STARTTLS command first
C: STARTTLS
S: 220 2.0.0 Ready to start TLS
   <TLS handshake: TLSv1.3>
C: EHLO workstation.example
S: 250-relay greets workstation.example
S: 250-SIZE 52428800
S: 250-AUTH LOGIN PLAIN
S: 250-ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES
S: 250-8BITMIME
S: 250 SMTPUTF8
C: MAIL FROM:<upkeep@example.net>
S: 530 5.7.0 Authentication required
C: AUTH PLAIN <upkeep, wrong password>
S: 535 5.7.8 Authentication credentials invalid
C: AUTH PLAIN <upkeep, right password>
S: 235 2.7.0 Authentication successful
C: MAIL FROM:<upkeep@example.net>
S: 250 2.1.0 Ok
C: RCPT TO:<owner@example.net>
S: 250 2.1.5 Ok
C: DATA
S: 354 Start mail input; end with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>
C: <message> .
S: 250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as 3o8j55ULHTsniP2Z2QJfYr
C: QUIT
S: 221 2.0.0 relay Mailpit ESMTP Service closing transmission channel
